title: The ENTIRE History of the Mongols in 15 Minutes | The Empire Built on Horseback
description:
More horses than people. No cities. No navy. At first, not even a written language.

And yet the Mongols built the largest connected land empire in history, ruling roughly a sixth of all the land on Earth.

From an abandoned boy on the frozen steppe to Genghis Khan, from the insult at Otrar to the fall of Baghdad, from the "divine wind" that saved Japan to the Black Death that swept into Europe. This is the complete story of the Mongol Empire. In 15 minutes.
